resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.warning: This immediately replaces {name}'s password. They will be signed out of the portal and will need the new password to get back in.
resetPassword.explainer: Nobody can read an existing password — not you, not us. Supabase keeps only a one-way scrambled copy, which is what makes passwords safe. What you can do is replace it and hand the new one over.
resetPassword.onceOnly: Copy this now. It is shown once and is stored nowhere — not in the audit trail, not in the database.
resetPassword.handOver: Give this to them in person or by phone, not by email, and ask them to change it once they are in.

editSettings.title: Platform settings
editSettings.description: The values every ladder is judged against.
editSettings.minimumHelp: No investment may be smaller, and every ladder must start here.
editSettings.capHelp: No tier may offer more than this.
editSettings.capBasisHelp: Whether the cap means per month, per quarter or per year.
editSettings.noticeHelp: Offered when an option is added. Not enforced.
editSettings.stepUpHelp: Publishing a ladder asks the administrator for their own password.
editSettings.stepUpOffWarning: With this off, anybody who can manage investment rules can change what the business owes people without confirming who they are.
editSettings.passwordHelp: Switching this off needs the password it switches off — otherwise the control could remove itself.
editSettings.impactTitle: This would break the ladder that is live
editSettings.impactBody: Nothing stops working and existing investments keep their terms, but the live ladder would no longer pass its own rules — so the next version copied from it cannot be published until the rates or ranges change.
editSettings.impactUnknown: Could not check what this would do to the live ladder.
